mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bot_registry (bot_id, label, wechat_user_id, wechat_bot_id, bot_token, base_url, last_active_at, last_login_at) VALUES (#{botId}, #{label}, #{wechatUserId}, #{wechatBotId}, #{botToken}, #{baseUrl}, datetime('now', 'localtime'), datetime('now', 'localtime')) ON CONFLICT(bot_id) DO UPDATE SET label = COALESCE(#{label}, label), wechat_user_id = COALESCE(#{wechatUserId}, wechat_user_id), wechat_bot_id = COALESCE(#{wechatBotId}, wechat_bot_id), bot_token = COALESCE(#{botToken}, bot_token), base_url = COALESCE(#{baseUrl}, base_url), last_active_at = datetime('now', 'localtime'), last_login_at = datetime('now', 'localtime')
mapper.select: SELECT bot_id AS botId, label, wechat_user_id AS wechatUserId, wechat_bot_id AS wechatBotId, bot_token AS botToken, base_url AS baseUrl, created_at AS createdAt, last_active_at AS lastActiveAt, last_login_at AS lastLoginAt FROM bot_registry ORDER BY created_at ASC
